notes: Read all 44 numbered source lines before editing. Coverage: imports useTranslation + VisuallyHidden (L1-2); the WCAG 2.4.1 JSDoc rationale incl. the sr-only/focusable composition, the first-interactive-element mount requirement, and the skipToContent|skip.to.content audit anchor (L4-22); the component declaration + useTranslation hook (L23-24); the VisuallyHidden render with as='a', focusable, data-testid='skip-to-content', href='#main-content', and the focus:* Tailwind styling block (L25-31); the onClick handler that preventDefaults, resolves getElementById('main-content'), focuses it, and scrollIntoViews (L32-39); the t('a11y.skipToContent','Skip to main content') label (L41); and the close + EOF (L42-44).

Source depends on browser-only behaviour with no universal native parity surface (rules 4/7), so a native-safe implementation was built with no DOM-only modules, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI components imported. The behavioural intent (an accessible skip affordance that hands focus to the main landmark) is preserved and functional -- it is not a render-nothing stub.

i18n: react-i18next is absent from the native deps, so useTranslation -> a local useNativeTranslationFallback that returns the inline English fallback while still referencing the a11y.skipToContent key (matching the sibling OfflineBanner / EmptyStateThreshold / BrowserCompatBanner ports). The 'Skip to main content' copy is preserved verbatim.

VisuallyHidden(as='a', focusable) -> a Pressable with accessibilityRole='link' (mirrors as='a') that is off-screen-but-accessible by default (styles.visuallyHidden: position absolute, 1x1, overflow hidden -- the native analog of Tailwind sr-only, still announced by screen readers). The focus:not-sr-only reveal is reproduced via onFocus/onBlur toggling a focused state; keyboard focus only fires on the macOS/Windows desktop runtimes, so on touch the link stays AT-only, matching the web behaviour on a touch device.

onClick logic preserved: e.preventDefault() is unnecessary on native onPress; document.getElementById('main-content') -> resolveMainContentTag(registeredMainContent) reading a module-level main-content registry (registerMainContent / unregisterMainContent + a __setMainContentTargetForTests seam) -- the native stand-in for the id='main-content' landmark and the href='#main-content' target (kept as the exported MAIN_CONTENT_ID constant). main.focus({preventScroll:false}) -> AccessibilityInfo.setAccessibilityFocus(tag) (RN analog of HTMLElement.focus); the `if (main)` guard maps to the `if (tag != null)` guard. scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) has no general native analog and is documented as omitted -- moving accessibility focus is the meaningful preserved behaviour.

Visual-intent mapping for the focus-visible chip (Tailwind -> native tokens): focus:left-4/top-4 -> left/top 16; focus:z-[200] -> zIndex 200; focus:rounded-lg -> borderRadius 8; focus:bg-[var(--surface-1)] -> colors.surface; focus:px-4/py-2 -> paddingHorizontal 16 / paddingVertical spacing.sm; focus:text-sm font-medium -> fontSize 14 / fontWeight '500'; focus:text-[var(--text-primary)] -> colors.textPrimary; focus:shadow-lg -> shadows.panel; focus:outline-none -> n/a on native; focus:ring-2 ring-[var(--theme-primary)] -> borderWidth 2 / borderColor colors.accent (the app theme-primary). data-testid='skip-to-content' -> testID='skip-to-content'. A default export is added to match the sibling feedback ports.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest).
